title: 第四十一章 怪物“攻城”
content_zh:
第四十一章 怪物“攻城”-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

爻雪以为，这棵金色柳树如此显眼，肯定会吸引来很多人，就连那些因忌惮她而独自躲藏的幸存者，也会因为好心人过来查看情况。

结果，人没有引来，倒是把附近的怪物全部都给引来了，而且数量还不少。

晚上，爻雪是被系统的声音给吵醒的。

刚想要骂人，就听到系统用焦急的声音说道：“不好了宿主，不好了，怪物攻城了，外面来了好多变异怪物，全部都是冲着你的柳树来的。”

闻言，爻雪来到顶楼，拿起望远镜看向远处，果然看到远处，永恒之契的边缘位置，围满了正在嘶吼的怪物，不仅仅是一面，而是周围三百六十度都有。

“系统，现在游戏商店里面一共有多少人了？”爻雪问道。

【大概一百多人，宿主，你不会是想要靠着一百多人对付这些怪物吧。】

系统的声音中还带着不可置信的语气。

“为什么不行呢，你看那些怪物，根本就无法突破永恒的契的保护罩，仅仅是围在外面而已，看上去跟活靶子有什么区别，你现在就给游戏商店内的所有人发布任务，让他们所有人都下来杀怪，所获得的晶核自己拿着，同时每杀死一只怪物，还可以额外获得十积分，以及凭借积分换取异能觉醒药剂。”

爻雪的这个系统虽然是废物了一点，但胜在听话，爻雪让它干什么就干什么。

让它发布任务的人，它就真的发布了任务，直接将那些还在睡梦中的人惊醒了。

这些人上一秒还睡得香甜，下一秒一睁眼就看到自己的面前出现了一个硕大的，红的仿佛要滴血的面板：

【警报！警报！怪物攻城，现发布强制任务，所有游戏商店的客人立刻前往外面营地，每杀死一只怪物，可额外获得十积分的奖励，任务结束之后，可凭借积分换取异能觉醒药剂。

该任务为强制任务，拒绝接受任务将会被直接赶出去。】

在看清楚任务内容之后，无论这些人是什么反应，一个个的都赶紧穿好衣服，朝着外面赶去。

Chapter 41: Monster "sieges the city" - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"

Yaoxue thought that because this golden willow tree was so conspicuous, it would definitely attract many people. Even those survivors who were hiding alone because they were afraid of her would come to check on the situation because of good-hearted people.

As a result, instead of attracting people, it attracted all the nearby monsters, and there were quite a few of them.

At night, Yaoxue was woken up by the sound of the system.

Just as he was about to curse, he heard the system say in an anxious voice: "It's not good, host, it's not good, the monsters are attacking the city. There are many mutant monsters outside, all aiming at your willow tree."

Hearing this, Yaoxue came to the top floor, picked up the telescope and looked into the distance. Sure enough, she saw in the distance, at the edge of the Eternal Contract, surrounded by roaring monsters, not just on one side, but all around 360 degrees.

"System, how many people are there in the game store now?" Yaoxue asked.

[About a hundred people, host, you don’t want to rely on more than a hundred people to deal with these monsters.】

There was a tone of disbelief in the system's voice.

"Why not? Look at those monsters. They can't break through the protective shield of the eternal contract. They are just surrounded outside. They look no different from living targets. Now you issue a task to everyone in the game store and ask them all to come down and kill the monsters. You can keep the crystal cores you get. At the same time, you can get an additional ten points for every monster you kill, and you can use the points to exchange for power awakening potions."

Although Yaoxue's system is a bit useless, it is better than being obedient, and Yaoxue will do whatever it is told to do.

If you ask it to issue a task, it will actually issue a task, directly waking up those who are still sleeping.

These people were sleeping soundly one second, but when they opened their eyes the next second, they saw a huge, red panel appearing in front of them, as if it was dripping blood:

【Alert!alarm!Monsters are attacking the city, and a mandatory mission is now released. All game store guests will go to the outside camp immediately. Each time a monster is killed, they will receive an additional ten points as a reward. After the mission is over, the points can be used to exchange for power awakening potions.

This task is a mandatory task. If you refuse to accept the task, you will be kicked out directly.】

After seeing clearly the content of the mission, no matter how these people reacted, they all quickly got dressed and hurried outside.
